profile.headline: Founder & CEO | Cloud Solutions | Cybersecurity | DevSecOps | Big Data | Software Engineering | Multimedia
profile.summary: Seasoned Senior Software Engineer & DevSecOps Specialist with 15+ years of hands-on experience designing, securing, and optimizing cloud-native applications for mission-critical government and private-sector projects. Proven ability to lead full-stack development, cloud infrastructure automation, and security engineering in high-stakes environments. Extensive experience delivering secure, scalable solutions for federal agencies, ensuring compliance with NIST 800-53, RMF, FISMA, and other cybersecurity frameworks. Skilled in architecting microservices, implementing CI/CD pipelines, and integrating DevSecOps best practices to enhance system resilience. Adept at conducting risk assessments, automating security processes, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to drive technical excellence in real-world operational settings. Passionate about leveraging automation, security, and cloud innovation to support national security and enterprise objectives.

positions.title: Founder & CEO
positions.description:
This venture marks the evolution of my long-standing creative and technical brand. What began in high school in 2003 as SoCheesy Designs and later t.graphikz, matured into TaylorTheory Multimedia & Design, LLC in 2018. Now, in 2025, I’m transitioning the company into a full-scale technology firm: Terability Inc., with a mission to deliver secure, scalable, and innovative solutions across cloud, DevOps, and software engineering.

Key Responsibilities:
• Leading the development of Terability Inc., a technology company specializing in cloud architecture, DevSecOps, cybersecurity, big data, and multimedia software
• Building proprietary, cloud-native software solutions alongside strategic consulting for businesses and government clients
• Driving strategic growth through partnerships, funding, and service expansion
• Creating educational content and hands-on training to support the next generation of professionals in cloud, security, and DevOps

Focus Areas:
	•	Secure infrastructure design
	•	Compliance automation (FedRAMP, NIST 800-53, etc.)
	•	Containerized application delivery
	•	AI-driven risk management and observability
	•	Tech for impact: multimedia + education

positions.title: Lead Engineer
positions.description:
Led and provided key security and management capabilities necessary to ensure quality of service, uptime, and monitoring of mission critical distributed systems using cloud services.

Upgraded and deployed security scanning tools as infrastructure as code using Jenkins, helm charts and custom configuration files to increase the security posture and utilize new features.

Implemented fluentbit to replace the Amazon CloudWatch Agent to reduce the overall cost of collecting and processing container logs to display in Splunk.

Designed runbooks to document workflows and automated processes.

Increased the projects overall readiness by swiftly deploying testing, demo and production environments.
Setup Kubernetes(k8s) clusters for running microservices in dedicated namespaces.

Ensured data encryption at rest and in transit, using AWS KMS and SSL/TLS protocols for securing sensitive data in cloud infrastructure.

Developed and maintained Docker Compose configurations to simplify multi-container orchestration during local development, ensuring parity between dev and production environments.

Deployed and managed web application services on AWS using services such as EC2, S3, RDS, and ECR, ensuring high availability and fault tolerance.

Implemented CI/CD pipelines with GiHub Actions and GitLab Runners for automated deployment of both front-end and back-end services to production environments.

Assisted developers with JavaScript framework upgrades and adding authentication functionality to the project’s web application.

Delegated DevOps tasks to team members and created detailed tickets through several sprint cycles.
Researched and compiled technical information into clear and concise documentation to satisfy project requirements.

positions.title: Lead Applications Programmer
positions.description:
Worked with an agile team in two week sprints to integrate a legacy Unix based application into a modernized windows environment using Angular, Java, Apache Tomcat, Windows Web-Servers and VMware, while applying applicable cyber security policies and secure coding principles.

Since joining the project I’ve developed several features to include a custom login screen with LDAP authentication, generated new REST api’s and implemented session based logging out and manual logout functionalities. I work closely with the test team to help verify bugs and assist with knowledge transfer /training.

positions.title: Software Engineer IV
positions.description: Worked with a team performing data extraction. Ingested data from elasticsearch using python 3.8 and exported the data into a mysql database in the Neo4j format. Designed a containerized architecture for the development environment to improve software engineering practices. Created and updated on-boarding documentation and procedures. Mentored teammates through one-on-one peer and group coding sessions. Participated in daily stand-up meetings.

positions.title: Software Engineer III
positions.description: Used my full-stack and DevSecOps expertise across various contracts. Primary skills used were JavaScript, Python, AWS(Linux EC2 instances), Scrum, Gitlab, Docker, ElasticSearch, Mysql, Openshift, JFrog Artifactory, Jenkins, Research and Documentation, and mentored teammates through one-on-one coding sessions. I worked with a large team to create a multi-service web application in Vue.js and then transitioned to a sub-team that focused on containerizing the existing multi-service application into a standalone environment. I wrote custom components for the applications centralized code library, fixed bugs/defects based on the customers feedback and assisted with updating back-end services in Python. I worked on and updated map features and functionality that relied on geolocation data. I designed and created a containerized architecture to streamline team member on-boarding and to keep enviornment dependencies consistent. This allowed the team to solely focus on development and not system level processes.

positions.title: Principal Cyber Software Engineer III
positions.description: Used my full-stack expertise across multiple agile teams to develop multi-service web applications, integrating converged networks using AWS and AZURE and containerizing applications for the customer. Primary skills used were Linux(Ubuntu), Javascript(React), GoLang(server-side rendering), Docker(containerized development process), cloud services(AZURE, AWS), JAVA(Apache Nifi, ActiveMQ and lamb functions), Python(lamb functions, data ingestion through web sockets). Lead a subtask with two team members to integrate an existing java based application in a containerized Azure environment.

positions.title: Research Consultant
positions.description: Used my coding and mathematical expertise to research the different techniques used to capture, monitor and analyze gait (a person's manner of walking) data. Primary skills used were research and development, coding, mathematics, problem solving, reading comprehension and active learning. I worked independently with my mentor’s assistance. I participated in weekly meetings to review the abstracts and technical papers I wrote in preparation to submit to research journals and to present at mathematical conferences. I wrote custom code using MATLAB to create a graphical user interface to display the processed gait data. I created several functions based on the Grobner Basis Theory (an algebraic technique) to ingest wrist and elbow data, transformed the data into the proper radian format and wrote scripts to load the radian formatted data into graphs. The graphs were able to visualize patterns during a gait cycle when a subject is carrying load and no load. After completing the research and coding portions, I presented the findings at mathematical symposiums and published the finds in biomedical and undergraduate journals.

positions.description: Used my coding and mathematical expertise to research the different techniques used to capture, monitor and analyze gait (a person's manner of walking) data. Primary skills used were research and development, coding, mathematics, problem solving, reading comprehension and active learning. I worked independently with my mentor’s assistance. I participated in weekly meetings to review the abstracts and technical papers I wrote in preparation to submit to research journals and to present at mathematical conferences. I wrote custom code using MATLAB to create a graphical user interface to display the processed gait data. I created several functions based on the Grobner Basis Theory (an algebraic technique) to ingest wrist and elbow data, transformed the data into the proper radian format and wrote scripts to load the radian formatted data into graphs. The graphs were able to visualize patterns during a gait cycle when a subject is carrying load and no load. After completing the research and coding portions, I presented the findings at mathematical symposiums and published the finds in biomedical and undergraduate journals.
